svg.title: One recorded DQN update
svg.desc: A table cell from Part 1 next to a Q-network. The network reads one state, position −1.115 and velocity 0.01445. Its value for pushing left moves from −0.1229 toward the target −1.122, and the same gradient step lowers the value of every visited state on the position and velocity map, by 0.016 to 0.022.
svg.text: Part 2: a Q-network, update 1 of the run
Darker: a larger drop. Dots: replayed states.
